name: New Era
verdict: Controlled by its founding family, the Koch family of Buffalo; private equity firm ACON Investments holds a significant stake and MLB, the NFL and the NBA became minority owners in 2022.
note: Official Cap of LIV Golf and its 13 teams (livgolf.com/partners); one of the two partner logos on the Cleeks GC team page. US leagues are private bodies, not states; no state in the owner chain found.
